Send or retry exact observation
Send the same finalized answers and photographs using the reserved server attempt? The server will check the exact content and prevent duplicate acceptance.

Verify the completed observation and save its receipt on this device? No answers or photographs will be sent.
Resume protected preparation
Resume preparation using the same encrypted request identity? This does not transmit the observation.
